---
★ Request
Small font
My amico is a wonderful esecutore!

How dazzling each and every note you played was!
They're etched deep into my heart! Benissimo!!

Earth also seemed to be having more fun than usual.
...Somehow, that's what I felt resonating from her melodies.

Grazie mille!
Let us revel in this session together!
...Molto bene.

I see. So that "invitation" was sent
by you and your violin, wasn't it?

Besides... it seemed you approached this
training camp with your own goals in mind as well.

Fantastico! Then these fireworks are none other than
applause gifted by the summer to your musica!
(Screeech... skrrrt...)

Sounds of Earth needed that decisive burst of speed right before the goal line.
So for this training camp, I had assigned her a rather grueling regimen.

It was unpolished technically, but I played each note with all my heart.
After all, that was the only thing I could do.

*pant* *pant* *pant*...
—Phew. I suppose that's all for today's training.

But none of that matters.
That is what my mother and everyone in l'orchestra taught me.

If you don't mind, won't you grant a request
from your one and only spettatore?

Please, let me join you on stage.
I want to weave musica alongside you to the cadence of the fireworks!

That performance will surely become—
the most beautiful session on this entire planet!
My amica is a wonderful esecutore!

So allow me once more to shower you,
such a wonderful esecutore, with my boundless praise!!

Ah, amore! All our training should have
concluded by noon today, but—

Then I have only to face every étude with all my might.
For I believe in your direction completely!

Fufu. So as not to be outdone by your fiamme,
I shall do my very best as well.

No musician plays brilliantly right from the start.
Even I was no different from you once.
Ah...
I nod and ready my violin.

The violin duet, interwoven with the melodies of fireworks,
turned into a piece far more breathtaking than a solo ever could be!

...! Sì, certo!
Ah, I am already looking forward to it!

Bene... Molto bene...!
What a passionate performance...!

Yet she kept up right to the very end without showing even a trace of strain.
And with complete, unwavering trust in me.

Not through words, but through music.
Because surely, that is what would bring her the greatest joy.

The regimen I assigned to Sounds of Earth for this camp
would have made an average Umamusume throw in the towel.

I can't produce exquisite tones like she does.
Even so—I should at least be able to convey my feelings.

I told her that once we understand each other more...
understand the music each of us plays, I'd love to perform a violin duet with her again.

In order to deeply understand Sounds of Earth,
I picked up the very instrument she had first played, but—

Wait, oh!? Fireworks!? Is this a surprise too?
You truly are a director of exquisite romance!
There is still so much I have yet to learn about Sounds of Earth.
From the Trainer? An "invitation," hmm...

One must not simply chase after technique.
The most vital element of a performance is passionate emozioni!

Thank you for such a wonderful concerto!
I savored your beautiful musica from the bottom of my heart.

Still, I learned that I could make her smile through music.
It was a huge step forward that words alone could never fully capture.

And then, you see, my fingers began to feel lighter and lighter.
Yes... My heart transformed into sound, reaching my mother and everyone.

Sì, certo!
You did tell me that completing this menu would lead to growth, did you not?

I play a piece I could hardly call my specialty.
I slow down at the difficult passages just so I won't make a mistake.

With a brief moment of free time before lights out,
I came down to the beach alone, violin in hand.
Braviiiiisssimo!!!!
(Screeech... skrrrt...)

It might take a little more time,
but I'll definitely become a conductor worthy of her. And someday—

It might take a little more time,
but I'll definitely become a conductor worthy of her. And someday—

It looked as though Sounds of Earth's lips moved faintly—
but drowned out by the fireworks and music, her voice didn't reach me.

There's another reason I've been practicing the violin like this.
I wanted to reward her for pushing through such a hard training camp.

By the way, amore.
Is the concerto already reaching its finale after just one song?

It happened when I was young, playing the violin in front of people for the very first time.
As a token of thanks to those who always played such bellissima music for me.

When I finished playing, I received a tremendous round of applause.
That sight is something I will never forget for the rest of my life.

As I took deep breaths to calm my nerves,
Sounds of Earth came walking over.

Our impetuoso training camp comes to an end today, does it...
Oh? An email?

Thank you for arranging such a lovely concerto.
Thanks to you, it has become a wonderful night.
